changed.what: Convention 7/8: the script used sim.run options owned by downstream beads (--steps N16b-25, --precision N35-04, job.cancel under frobd) and an unregistered capacity forcing. The e2e was rewritten: --seconds 0.4 resolving to 200 steps; a list file from N17b-03's workload.toml; stage 4a runs N17b-02's two-model kernel check; f64 through the crate lane. The round-2 request from S34 was applied: the SIGINT cancel is N32a-08's (exit 2, one envelope, job.state cancelled). Part 1 of the done-condition now leaves a receipt; N17a-10 is the one recorder of GATE-PHYLUM-02.

The e2e used BD-170's lowering, which comes after this bead. Reachability now goes through spark.check (N21b-32 inputs, --list from N21a-04): K-variant-gather on batch-cpu against the batch-cpu reference attains class exact, and the check is repeated at --workers 1 and 24 with equal digests, each call under its own key with replay checks. The two-model sim.run run moved to BD-170's stage 4a, and Scope Out names it.

The reachability top-up now draws 320 (299 plus N17b-03's margin) from the sealed reserve in key order. A clause observed below 299 is 'not decidable'. reachability_tops_up_path was updated to match (120 cool plus 200; 305 decidable; 250 and 298 not decidable). The gate is recorded with record_gate for GATE-PHYLUM-04, and the script writes no gate record. Quantiles 499, 527 and 299 verified.
Publication: GATE-PHYLUM-03 is recorded with record_gate from the receipt; the KILL-PHYLUM decision record is N17b-10's. Arithmetic verified (H = 2.105, bound 0.735, the mixing ratios).

The campaign command used libtest's rejected --seeds; it is now FROB_REUSE_SEEDS=0..10000 cargo test -p frob-phylum --release --test reuse_campaign. The user-path replay now uses registered inputs only: design edit with a key, design show --products against --no-memo, and phylum sweep against sim run --designs/--worlds-per-design/--steps, all under g05 keys with replay checks. Reuse is asserted through memo.served in the cost block (N28b-38). record_gate is used for GATE-PHYLUM-05. The S71 request was not applied here: step 5 of N19cx-02 calls phylum.reuse, whose surface and script are N17b-14's, so it went to N17b-14.

Keys added for the design.edit and phylum.sweep calls (g08-<run>-<brief>-<seed>-<arm>-<round>-<i>), with idempotent_replay false required. GATE-PHYLUM-08 is recorded with record_gate. The bound 0.453 was verified.

The adjoint refusal owner is now N16c-26 (Moonshot, M6, with KILL-STEPADJOINT; it adds --both-sides and 602), not the epic BD-422. The KILL-FDGRAD final reading is docs/adr/ADR-KILL-FDGRAD-M4-final.md with reading = final (N40-03 fields), beside N17b-20's first reading docs/adr/ADR-KILL-FDGRAD-M4.md, and the bead closes either way. GATE-PHYLUM-06 is recorded with record_gate. A key paragraph (pg-<run>-<step>-<index>) covers phylum.gradient, eval.compare and design.edit, with step 7 as the one deliberate replay.
Pilot register path corrected to crates/frob-conformance/registry/pilots.toml, schema frob.gauntlet.pilot/1 (N38a-09).

No bead resolved @workload:h2h-512, which N17a-10, N17b-04, N17b-11, N17b-25 and the cohort scripts pass to --designs; STD-E2E leaves @workload: to its own bead. Added the reference name and its resolver frob_phylum::workload::resolve, which returns the WorkloadId and 512 DesignIds in file order from the committed file and echoes them in the bound block. An unknown name gets N34-24's code. assets/phylum/workloads.toml lists the names. Also added an acceptance item and the unit test workload_reference_resolves. N17b-03 precedes every user (BD-170, BD-171, N17b-04, N17b-11, N17a-10).

The unregistered 'determinism refusal' is replaced by 761 (exit 4, appended by NJL-01), with the evidence block naming the class attained. --solve-queues off is always accepted; once admitted, the option is valid only with --profile lockstep (N16c-15). The registry's other extensions are named: --tables (N21b-17), --fill licensed (N25e-07, 852) and --capacity-step (N17a-10). The acceptance item and sweep_options_gated match.
Decision record named docs/adr/ADR-OPEN-PHYLUM-3.md (convention 4).

Convention 10: the record is docs/adr/ADR-KILL-PHYLUM-M2.md with N40-03's required fields and outcomes: fired for K1-K3; not-fired; deferred with deferred_to for the lead's optimization pass; not-reached. The lead's choice in the in-between case is recorded beside the outcome, never as a rule's output. The kill row has a decision entry. The acceptance item checks the path and the loader codes, and the bead closes either way. The sweep gains --task flat-stand.

Records named docs/adr/ADR-OPEN-PHYLUM-1.md, -2.md and -5.md. The e2e re-ran the run-length comparison through phylum.sweep, but no input of that verb selects a run length, and the runs are N17a-06's steps 4 and 5 (executed once). The script now loads N17a-06's data records by digest, recomputes decisions 2 and 3 against the fixed criteria and asserts them equal to the recorded values. It also checks digest equality across run lengths and logs the paired bounds and Degraded rates against 1.03 and 10^-4.
sim.run calls in the script now carry keys (rcal-<run>-<i>) and require idempotent_replay false, because a replayed envelope would count no memo hit.

S71's request was applied here as step 9 plus an acceptance item: N19cx-02's scene_map_address.sh step 5 runs and passes. The setup sweep and every design edit carry keys (reuse-<run>-...) with replay checks. The recomputation, which was an unregistered --no-memo on unnamed verbs, is now design show --products --no-memo for analyses and sim run --designs/--worlds-per-design/--steps for episodes. phylum reuse calls take --design as the row requires. The gate is recorded by BD-286 from its receipt.

The H-verbs-4 request was applied: --page-size 50 became --limit 50 with --cursor (NJL-01 common properties). The two agents' sweeps carry keys (map-<run>-a|b) with replay checks, since a replayed dispatch adds no map and the merge assertions would hold vacuously.

Pilot register path corrected to crates/frob-conformance/registry/pilots.toml (frob.gauntlet.pilot/1, N38a-09). The script's sim.run now takes the design as the positional (--designs is per-slot and excludes --worlds) and runs on a conformance build. --kernel-arm is the conformance-build-only input this bead owns (802 in a release build; enters manifest and StepPlanId).

The script refused a planted archetype kernel through spark.check with 613. At this milestone spark.check has no planting input (--mutant is N21b-42's), and its 613 comes under --specialized (N21c-19, M4); both come after this bead. The script now runs spark check --list and, for each archetype kernel, --kernel/--backend/--reference/--seed/--lanes with keys, requiring class exact. The planted kernel is asserted in-process through checker_refuses_reassociated and a new unit test, planted_archetype_runs_generic: refused at environment build, worlds on the generic path, digests equal.

Convention 9: the gate row is no longer written by the script. GATE-PHYLUM-09 is recorded with record_gate from the receipt (partial at M2), and N17bp1-01 completes it. Convention 10: the final reading is docs/adr/ADR-KILL-LIMBKERNEL-M2-final.md with the kill row's second M2 entry reading = final, outcome fired or not-fired, recorded by a non-implementing session. The acceptance items match. The step-6 refusal sweep gains --task flat-stand so that 724, not a schema refusal, answers.

Convention 10: the record is docs/adr/ADR-KILL-LIMBKERNEL-M2.md with N40-03's fields and outcomes (fired: falsifier, coverage or digest mismatch; not-fired: fund; not-reached: pilot incomplete at exit). The coverage re-reading is docs/adr/ADR-KILL-LIMBKERNEL-M3.md with an M3 decision entry, which needs reread = [M3] on the kill row (requested of N40-29). requests.what: Register the conformance-build-only input `--capacity-step 1|max` on sim.run, owner BD-170 (M2). 1 is the next larger bucket and max the largest bucket that admits the design; with no larger bucket, raised contact and row capacities in N17a-10's sequence. It enters the manifest and StepPlanId, and a release build answers 802. BD-170's script and its unit test capacity_step_places use it.

(1) phylum.plan's `--designs` lists design keys, a list file, an archive selector and a population descriptor, but N17a-10, N17b-11 and N17b-25 pass the workload reference `@workload:h2h-512`, and N17bp1-01 passes `@corpus:<id>`. Admit both references as phylum.sweep's row admits a workload reference. The workload resolver is N17b-03's frob_phylum::workload::resolve. (2) The `--capacity-step` row of phylum.sweep (N17a-10) has no build gating, while the same test option on sim.run is conformance-build-only (BD-170). Make the two agree; conformance-only is suggested for a test option.

KILL-LIMBKERNEL (decided M2) needs `reread = ["M3"]`: N17bp1-01 re-reads its coverage clause on the frozen design corpus at M3 (docs/adr/ADR-KILL-LIMBKERNEL-M3.md), and N40-03 decides an exit row without reread only once.

Name the first-reading record `docs/adr/ADR-KILL-FDGRAD-M4.md` with N40-03's required fields and one of the four outcomes, and give the kill row's M4 decision entry no `reading`. BD-353's final reading is `docs/adr/ADR-KILL-FDGRAD-M4-final.md` with reading = final and cites that path. The current text says 'An architecture decision record' and 'marked first reading'.

Step 5 of scene_map_address.sh (`frob phylum reuse` on a mirror-swapped pair) should be logged `e2e_skip "needs N17b-14"`, not 'needs BD-286'. N17b-14 owns the verb's surface and script and now runs that step as its step 9, with an acceptance item. N17b-14 depends on BD-286, which depends on N19cx-02.
